review.scope: All 100 images reviewed in contact sheets; listed originals additionally inspected at full resolution for the implemented changes. Mixed reference set includes GP, other motorcycle modes and interface views.

observations.feature: Formed GP frame, sculpted GP-R2 tank, saddle and connected thin fairing
observations.observation: Tank-to-saddle continuity, formed frame mass, inset hardware and clear steering well. Original dimensions; no image-derived engineering measurements.
One connected pelvis/waist/shoulder silhouette, broad integrated aero housing, embedded garment roots across tuck and corner poses.
Repeated garage bays, upper terraces, recessed glass, overhanging roofs and readable exposed supports. Original venue-specific architecture follows existing pit geometry.
Compact timing and training feedback is a presentation cue. The entry/apex/exit windows, record rules and thresholds are original code, not measured from screenshots.

authorship: New geometry is procedural Three.js/TypeScript. No reference pixels or branded source-game assets were copied into runtime assets.
limits: This is a targeted improvement pass, not a claim that all references have been reproduced or that the procedural game has reached photographic realism.
